h1.en: WHAT is a Popout: M9 Automatic Plaster Spraying Machine

directAnswer.en: Popouts is only the order of the sections. The cells under those headings stay the cells already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes M9 Automatic Plaster Spraying Machine.  The published table prints Power Supply 380 V / 50 Hz; Output Capacity 30 L/min; Max. Outlet Pressure 50 bar; Delivery Distance (H / V) 50 m / 20 m; Hose Diameter 25 mm; Hopper Capacity 115 L; Loading Height 90 cm; Max. Particle Size ≤4 mm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 1230 × 720 × 1550 mm; Main Unit Weight 200 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.

body.en: Under the source heading “WHY do Popouts Occur”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. The photograph on this page is a content image downloaded from the crawled source page. It is not a Pinjin catalogue sheet. A diameter, output, distance or material grade is used here only when the Xingtai table prints it. Figures that are not readable on the photograph stay blank. Another manufacturer's rating is not written onto this Pinjin model or part. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number.
body.zh: 在来源标题“为什么会出现表面爆裂”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。本文图片是从来源页正文下载的内容图，不是品锦目录页。直径、产量、距离或材料牌号，只有邢台参数表印了才写入。照片上读不出来的数字保持空白。其他厂家的参数不写到这个品锦型号或配件上。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。

body.en: Under the source heading “HOW to Avoid Popouts”, the wording that follows is the printed catalogue fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai and name M9 Automatic Plaster Spraying Machine. Match the printed output, pressure, hose, particle size and distance on this page. This spraying machine is not a trailer concrete pump. The specification table does not include a price cell.
body.zh: 在来源标题“如何避免表面爆裂”下面，接着写的是已经印出的目录片段。请用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明M9全自动石膏喷涂机。对照本页已印的产量、压力、管径、粒径和距离。这台喷涂机不是拖式混凝土泵。参数表没有价格格。
